prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Computer or software programmer (preferably javascript) needed for application development
It is for a capstone project that we must develop. It is similar to google maps but instead of directions. It is with jeepney routes within Davao City with a fare generator. Depending on the desired location of the user. We would also like to include road information or news. One familiar application is the Davao Commuter’s Guide.
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
title: Monthly statement PDF generator
client: Alder Property Group
client_industry: real estate
start: 2022-07
end: 2022-09
engagement: fixed
stack:

- BullMQ

  instead of building them on request.

- request timeouts went from daily to none

Style:
- Open with a generic line about being passionate and hard-working.
- Mention these projects by what was built and one result each: Monthly statement PDF generator (p07).

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working full stack developer with extensive experience building JavaScript-based applications, and I’d be glad to help with your capstone project.

Your project is a strong fit for my background in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, and full stack development. I understand that you need an application similar to Google Maps, but focused on jeepney routes within Davao City, with a fare generator based on the user’s desired destination, plus road information or news. That kind of project needs a clear user interface, reliable routing logic, and a backend that can organize route and fare data cleanly.

I can help you build this in a way that is simple to use and easy to extend. For a project like this, I would focus on creating a smooth interface for searching locations, viewing jeepney route options, and showing fare estimates clearly. I can also structure the system so that road updates or commuter news can be displayed in a practical way, depending on how you want the capstone to present those features.

One relevant project I built was a Monthly statement PDF generator for Alder Property Group, where I created a queue that renders owner statements to PDF overnight and stores them in S3 instead of building them on request. This handled 12k statements a month and reduced request timeouts from daily to none. That experience is relevant because it required careful backend design, processing logic, and dependable delivery of generated outputs.

If you want, I can help turn your capstone idea into a polished application with a good structure, clean UI, and solid functionality. I’m comfortable working across both frontend and backend, and I’d be happy to discuss how to best organize the jeepney route, fare generator, and road information features for your project.
